title: werauhia picta

It is native to the tropical forests of South America, where it grows as an epiphyte on tree trunks and branches. The health benefits of Werauhia picta include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which have been traditionally used to treat various ailments such as wounds and respiratory issues.
